title: A Transformer-Derived Iterative Preconditioner
abstract: arXiv:2611.22941v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Transformers trained on in-context prediction problems can learn known numerical algorithms, e.g., gradient descent. We go further, showing that their internal computations can reveal new algorithms with provable guarantees. A softmax-attention transformer trained to solve linear systems $Xw=y$ implicitly improves matrix conditioning. Tracing $XX^\top$ reveals an iterative preconditioning primitive, which we develop into RAPID, a standalone algorithm requiring no learned components.   RAPID is an anytime preconditioner for symmetric positive definite (SPD) matrices, using randomized mixing and sparse local corrections to improve conditioning. Proof-of-concept experiments on synthetic and real-world problems consistently improve conditioning and reduce conjugate gradient iterations needed to reach a target accuracy. translated_abstract: 在上下文预测问题上训练的Transformer能够学习已知的数值算法，例如梯度下降。我们更进一步，证明它们的内部计算可以揭示具有可证明保证的新算法。一个经训练用于求解线性系统 $Xw=y$ 的softmax-attention Transformer会隐式地改善矩阵的条件性。通过追踪 $XX^\top$，我们发现了一个迭代预条件化原语，并将其发展为RAPID——一个无需任何学习组件的独立算法。RAPID是一种适用于对称正定（SPD）矩阵的“随时可用”型预条件子，利用随机混合和稀疏局部修正来改善矩阵条件性。在合成问题和真实问题上的概念验证实验表明，该方法持续改善条件数，并减少了达到目标精度所需的共轭梯度迭代次数。对于Haar混合的理想化情形，我们证明了无论谱分布如何，该算法都能收敛到任意固定的目标条件数。
tldr: 该论文从Transformer的内部计算中提炼出迭代预条件化原语，发展出无需学习组件的独立算法RAPID，可有效改善SPD矩阵条件数并减少共轭梯度求解所需迭代次数，且具有理论收敛保证。
en_tdlr: This paper extracts an iterative preconditioning primitive from a Transformer's internal computations to develop RAPID, a standalone algorithm requiring no learned components, which effectively improves the conditioning of SPD matrices, reduces conjugate gradient iterations, and comes with provable convergence guarantees.
